title: 第一卷 第9章 82分的废物，也配我家帝子？
novel_title: 开局自曝系统，家族助我娶妻成仙！
content_zh:
太凰仙朝虽是人族势力，却与太古神凰一族渊源颇深。

    皇族天骄血脉强悍，既拥有人族的根脚与悟性，又拥有不输太古异种的肉身强度！

    沐风凰作为仙朝帝君和帝后的掌上明珠，天生拥有‘凰极涅槃神体’，出生时引发天地异象。更有老祖断言，此女乃是太凰仙朝十万年以来，资质最高的存在，有大帝之姿！

    因此，这些年来，面对各方天骄的追求示好，她都嗤之以鼻。

    “我沐风凰将来必定证道成帝，要嫁也只嫁大帝！”沐风凰眼神坚定，沉声道，“即便是足以叫板大帝的大成圣体，也配不上我！”

    “更何况，他只是一个无法修炼的废物……”

    说完，沐风凰推开侍女，朝着殿外走去。

    侍女见状，连忙问道：“公主，您要去哪？”

    “太凰殿！”

    沐风凰贝齿紧咬，一脸厌恶：“我要当着姜家和仙朝强者的面，狠狠地拒绝姜无痕这个废物。我要让姜家知道，不是什么狗尾巴草，都能染指我沐风凰的！”

    音落，她不顾众人劝阻，毅然决然的走出了青凰殿。

    ……

    帝都，太凰殿。

    作为太凰仙朝权力巅峰的象征，这座极尽豪华的大殿，占地足有数千丈。

    极品灵石铺就的玉阶，圣阶宝药交错的花圃，就连殿里的柱子，用的都是铸造准帝兵的材料。

    道纹繁复，处处相连，仿佛浑然一体。

    姜无痕在姜临天、姜临渊等人的簇拥下，见到了太凰仙朝的帝君沐乾钊和帝后苏灵熙。

    靠山王沐启凌和一众皇族强者作陪，整个太凰殿内，座无虚席！

    “姜家主，方才在仙舟之上，你说……是来替你家帝子提亲的？”

    沐乾钊端坐龙椅之上，眼神不善。

    “没错！”

    姜临天点头道。

    “哼！”

    一旁的沐启凌冷哼一声，眼神中满是不屑。

    其他皇族强者同样表情阴沉，对姜家众人充满了敌意。

    但他们并未开口，只是在等沐乾钊表态。

    这时，一旁沉默许久的帝后苏灵熙忽然开口：“姜家主，别怪本宫心直口快。你们姜家帝子无论资质还是前途，与其父亲完全没有可比性。这样一个无法修炼的凡人，也妄想娶我皇族天骄，是否有些自不量力？”

    苏灵熙不仅是太凰仙朝的帝后，还曾是太玄仙门的神女。

    一身强悍修为，达到了准帝第八重。

    放眼阎浮大世界，也是排的上号的强者！

    只是这般生硬的语气，顿时惹得姜家众人不满。

    姜临渊脸色阴沉，正要怒斥反驳，却被姜临天制止。

    “帝后岂不知，士别三日，当刮目相看！”姜临天轻笑，解释道，“无痕乃我族大帝唯一血脉，又怎会是泛泛之辈？是因为他的体质特殊，不同于寻常圣体……”

    话音未落，却被沐启凌冷笑打断：“体质特殊？”

    “姜家主，你这是将我们都当成了傻子，觉得我们好糊弄是吗？”

    “凡人就是凡人，说破大天都改变不了他无法修炼的事实。让一个凡人娶走帝君和帝后的掌上明珠，你觉得……这件事可能吗？”
content_en:
Although the Taihuang Immortal Dynasty is a human race force, it has a deep connection with the Ancient Divine Phoenix Clan.

The royal genius has a strong bloodline. He not only has the foundation and understanding of the human race, but also has the physical strength that is not inferior to the ancient alien species!

Mu Fenghuang, as the apple of the eye of the emperor and empress of the Immortal Dynasty, was born with the 'Phoenix Nirvana Divine Body', which caused strange phenomena in the world when she was born.The ancestor even asserted that this woman is the most qualified being in the Taihuang Immortal Dynasty for 100,000 years, with the appearance of a great emperor!

Therefore, over the years, she has scorned the pursuit and overtures of geniuses from all walks of life.

"I, Mu Fenghuang, will definitely attain enlightenment and become an emperor in the future. If I want to marry, I will only marry the emperor!" Mu Fenghuang's eyes were firm and she said in a deep voice, "Even the Great Holy Body, which is enough to challenge the emperor, is not worthy of me!"

"What's more, he is just a waste who cannot cultivate..."

After saying that, Mu Fenghuang pushed the maid aside and walked out of the palace.

Seeing this, the maid quickly asked: "Princess, where are you going?"

"Taihuang Palace!"

Mu Fenghuang clenched her teeth tightly with a look of disgust on her face: "In front of the Jiang family and the strong men of the Immortal Dynasty, I will severely reject Jiang Wuhen, this loser. I want the Jiang family to know that not just some dogtail grass can get its hands on me, Mu Fenghuang!"

When the sound fell, she ignored everyone's dissuasion and walked out of the Qinghuang Palace resolutely.

…

Imperial Capital, Taihuang Palace.

As a symbol of the peak power of the Taihuang Immortal Dynasty, this extremely luxurious hall covers an area of ​​several thousand feet.

The jade steps paved with top-grade spiritual stones, the flower beds intertwined with sacred treasures, and even the pillars in the temple are all made of materials used to cast quasi-emperor weapons.

The Dao patterns are complex and connected everywhere, as if they are integrated.

Jiang Wuhen, surrounded by Jiang Lintian, Jiang Linyuan and others, met Emperor Mu Qianzhao and Emperor Su Lingxi of the Taihuang Immortal Dynasty.

Backing King Mu Qiling and a group of powerful royal family members accompanied him, and the entire Taihuang Palace was packed with seats!

"Master Jiang, you were on the immortal boat just now. You said... you were here to propose marriage for your emperor's son?"

Mu Qianzhao sat upright on the dragon chair with an unkind look in his eyes.

"That's right!"

Jiang Lintian nodded.

"Hmph!"

Mu Qiling on the side snorted coldly, his eyes full of disdain.

The other powerful members of the royal family also had gloomy expressions and were full of hostility towards everyone in the Jiang family.

But they didn't speak, just waiting for Mu Qianzhao to express his position.

At this time, the Empress Su Lingxi, who had been silent for a long time, suddenly spoke: "Master Jiang, don't blame me for being outspoken. You, the emperor of the Jiang family, are completely incomparable with his father in terms of qualifications and prospects. Isn't it overestimating his ability for such a mortal who cannot cultivate to want to marry the genius of my royal family?"

Su Lingxi was not only the empress of Taihuang Immortal Dynasty, but also the goddess of Taixuan Immortal Sect.

His powerful cultivation level has reached the eighth level of Quasi-Emperor.

Looking at the great world of Jambu, he is also ranked among the strongest!

But such a harsh tone immediately made everyone in the Jiang family dissatisfied.

Jiang Linyuan's face was gloomy, and he was about to retort angrily, but was stopped by Jiang Lintian.

"Don't you know, the emperor and empress, that after three days of separation, you should look at each other with admiration!" Jiang Lintian chuckled and explained, "Wuhen is the only bloodline of our great emperor, how can he be an ordinary person? It is because his physique is special, different from ordinary holy bodies..."

Before he finished speaking, he was interrupted by Mu Qiling's sneer: "You have a special physique?"

"Master Jiang, do you think we are all fools? Do you think we are easy to fool?"

"Mortals are mortals, and no matter how hard they say it, it can't change the fact that he can't practice. Do you think... is it possible for a mortal to marry the apple of the eye of the emperor and the empress?"
